QuestInfo.name: Borrowing Sera's Mirror
QuestInfo.1: I met #b#p1##k, who's worried the sun is damaging her skin. I should get her mirror from her sister, #b#p2##k, so she can check.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p1##k asked me to get a mirror from her sister, so I walked all the way to #b#p2##k.

0.0: You must be the new traveler. I'll be giving you important information, so listen up. First, if you want to talk to anyone, #bclick#k that person with your mouse.
0.1: The #bleft and right arrows#k allow you to move. Press #bAlt#k to jump. Press a direction key and #bAlt#k at the same time to jump left or right.
0.2: Man, it's scorching hot today! The sun is burning my beautiful skin! Can you get me my #bmirror#k from #b#p2##k, please? I have to check my skin!
0.3: If you want to keep track of your progress on a quest, open your #bQuest Window#k, then press #bQuest Helper#k to register it. Quests registered to the Quest Helper will display on your screen while you play.

yes.0: Thank you. #b#p2##k is on the hill to the east, hanging laundry. The mirror looks like this: #i4031000#.

no.0: Don't want to? Fine, come back when you change your mind.

npc.0: Haven't met up with #b#p2##k yet? She is up on the hill to the east. It shouldn't be hard to find her.
